Global (All).title: Russia Warns of Global 'Catastrophe' Over Oil Cap
Global (All).summary: G7 and EU leaders agreed to impose a 60-million-barrel ceiling on Russian crude exports in December, Russia sees this as an economic catastrophe for them and they could potentially stop oil supplies to other countries.

Global (All).title: China Sees Worst Economic Growth Since 1990s Amid Xi's Reforms
Global (All).summary: China has seen its worst economic growth since the 1990s, as President Xi Jinping pursues his ambitious campaign of reforms.

Global (All).title: Taiwan Reports Chinese Invasion Threats and Espionage
Global (All).summary: Taiwan reported multiple instances of Chinese military invasion and espionage threats.

United States.title: Violent protests break out in multiple U.S. cities over police brutality
United States.summary: Protests turn violent in major U.S. cities due to ongoing tensions between police and minority communities.

United States.summary: A massive data breach in the U.S. affected millions of people, compromising sensitive personal data.

United States.title: Tensions rise between the U.S. and China over trade and security issues
United States.summary: U.S.-China relations are strained as both countries engage in a war of words over trade, security, and human rights.

South Korea.summary: North Korea has conducted several missile tests near South Korea, heightening tensions in the region.

South Korea.title: Protests Against President Yoon's Policies
South Korea.summary: Thousands of protesters have taken to the streets to demonstrate against President Yoon's policies, including labor reforms and economic austerity measures.

South Korea.title: Cyberattacks on South Korean Firms
South Korea.summary: Several major South Korean firms have been hit by cyberattacks, with stolen data and financial information being sold on the dark web.

Japan.summary: North Korea fired multiple ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan on August 4, in a move that has heightened tensions in the region.

Japan.title: Protests against COVID-19 restrictions escalate in Japan
Japan.summary: Protests against COVID-19 restrictions in Japan have been ongoing for several days, with some reports of clashes between protesters and police.

Japan.title: Tensions rise between Japan and China over disputed islands
Japan.summary: Tensions have risen in recent days between Japan and China over a disputed set of islands in the East China Sea, with some fears of a potential clash.
